usedFor: Productive.io holds budgets, and “New Budgets” can write into Google Docs via “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Budgets” in Productive.io, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A newly created budget turns into text in the Google Doc tab you pick.

watchOut: “Update Budgets” fires on every change, and “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace existing tab content.
